summary: Implemented a looping typewriter effect for the hero role text using React state and effect in the Home page, and added a professional programmer-style global loader via app/loading.tsx that shows animated terminal-like logs and a code icon while pages are loading.
current_status: The portfolio now has an animated hero badge that types and deletes the 'Frontend Developer • Next.js Expert' role in both languages, and a global Next.js loading screen that appears before pages finish loading; all recent changes build successfully with only non-blocking Tailwind lint warnings.
